Who we are

BNX Group is a forward-thinking real estate company committed to building spaces that inspire trust, comfort, and long-term value. With a strong foundation in engineering excellence and strategic business vision, we aim to redefine modern real estate by delivering projects that balance quality, innovation, and sustainability.

Our approach is simple—create developments that are not just structures, but meaningful spaces where people live, grow, and invest with confidence. From residential to commercial projects, BNX Group focuses on precision, transparency, and customer satisfaction at every stage.

Driven by a leadership team with diverse expertise, we combine technical strength with market insight to deliver results that stand out in today's competitive landscape.

Our Leadership

The Leaders Behind BNX Group

A team of visionaries and professionals working together to build a stronger, smarter future.

Aditya Goel

Chairman & Managing Director

With a background in Civil Engineering, Aditya Goel brings strong technical knowledge and on-ground execution expertise to BNX Group. His leadership ensures that every project is built with structural integrity, quality standards, and long-term durability in mind. He plays a key role in shaping the company's vision and driving operational excellence.

Pratham Goyal

Director & Co-Founder

An MBA by qualification, Pratham Goyal leads the strategic and business development side of BNX Group. His focus lies in market positioning, growth strategy, and building strong client relationships. With a modern and dynamic approach, he ensures the brand stays relevant, scalable, and future-ready.
